coverage_decision: All 15 main-text figures and both main-text tables were visually inspected and represented in the SEA artifact as structured blocks; no supplement was present.
omissions: Pure bibliography pages 15-16 were excluded from ATOM extraction but transcribed to the separate references Markdown file.

source_internal_consistency_findings.issue: Narrative says 473 database records plus 1 hand-search record = 474; the database-specific counts shown in Figure 1 sum to 474 before adding the hand-search record, so the component counts do not reconcile with the stated total.
source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: Preserved the reported totals and recorded the mismatch; no count was silently corrected.

source_internal_consistency_findings.issue: Results narrative reports approximately 49.36% of patients had diabetes, whereas the Table 1 summary reports 51.1%.
source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: Both source-reported values were retained and tagged as inconsistent.

source_internal_consistency_findings.issue: The paper repeatedly describes the mortality endpoint as in-hospital all-cause mortality, while Table 2 labels follow-up as ranging from 5 to 90 days.
source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: The atom uses the Table 2 follow-up range and flags the source labeling conflict.

source_internal_consistency_findings.issue: Table 2 reports 20/420 control vs 15/423 early SGLT2i but prints RR 1.20 (95% CI 0.27–5.25), a direction inconsistent with the displayed event rates; it also labels 3 RCTs while listing only references [15,16].
source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: Reported RR, CI, event counts, participant count, and study count were preserved exactly; discrepancy flagged without recalculation.

source_internal_consistency_findings.location: Methods risk-of-bias inclusion vs sensitivity analysis
source_internal_consistency_findings.issue: Methods state that only low-risk or some-concerns studies were included, yet sensitivity analysis is described as removing high-risk studies.
source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: Both statements retained as a methods-logic inconsistency.

source_internal_consistency_findings.issue: The Results sentence refers to symptomatic hypertension, while Figure 12 and Table 2 specify symptomatic hypotension.
source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: Outcome atom follows the figure/table label (symptomatic hypotension) and the prose typo is flagged.

source_internal_consistency_findings.location: Serious adverse events narrative vs pooled figure/table
source_internal_consistency_findings.issue: Results prose attributes the significant serious-adverse-event reduction to empagliflozin, while Figure 15 and Table 2 label the pooled intervention as early dapagliflozin and empagliflozin.
source_internal_consistency_findings.handling: The atom follows the pooled Table 2/figure label and records the intervention-label discrepancy.
